messages.author: f02bc43326e504a7
messages.subject: Re: Create two inputs side by side on the SideBarPanel?
parts:
Hey guys,
I am *very* new to all this but think I found a workable solution.  It all comes down to the bootstrap scaffolding.  I was trying to get 4 data inputs into one line and found this thread.  I think if you include an "offset" column then you will get the desired result.  This is from what I am working on:

    div(class='row',
        div(class="span2 offset1", numericInput("CPC", "CPC:", .392,min=0,max=1,step=0.001)),
        div(class="span2", numericInput("LPC", "LPC:", .189,min=0,max=1,step=0.001)),
        div(class="span2", numericInput("NDP", "NDP:", .306,min=0,max=1,step=0.001)),
        div(class="span2", numericInput("GRN", "GRN:", .061,min=0,max=1,step=0.001))
    ),
    tags$style(type="text/css", '#CPC {width: 50px;}'),
    tags$style(type="text/css", '#LPC {width: 50px;}'),
    tags$style(type="text/css", '#NDP {width: 50px;}'),
    tags$style(type="text/css", '#GRN {width: 50px;}'),

It worked for me.  Hope that helps!
Best,
John
